# Gushwork

## Hiring for 11 positions

Gushwork builds AI marketing employees that empower B2B companies to enhance their online presence in the evolving digital landscape. By creating a content engine that attracts both AI and human visitors, we enable traditional industries to thrive without the need for additional human resources. Our innovative approach positions us at the forefront of the shift towards AI-driven discovery and engagement.
